+def _tokenize(formula: str) -> list[tuple[str, str | int | float]]:
+    tokens: list[tuple[str, str | int | float]] = []
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(formula):
+        c = formula[i]
+        if c.isspace():
+            i += 1
+            continue
+
+        m = _NUMBER_RE.match(formula, i)
+        if m:
+            s = m.group()
+            tokens.append(("NUMBER", int(s) if "." not in s else float(s)))
+            i = m.end()
+            continue
+
+        m = _NAME_RE.match(formula, i)
+        if m:
+            tokens.append(("NAME", m.group()))
+            i = m.end()
+            continue
+
+        if c in "+-*/%^(),":
+            tokens.append((c, c))
+            i += 1
+            continue
+
+        raise EvalError(f"unexpected character: {c!r}")
+
+    return tokens
